Fcm._comment: FCM HTTP v1 config. ProjectId = your Firebase project ID. ServiceAccountJsonPath = path (absolute, or relative to the Service's install directory) to a Google service-account key JSON with 'Firebase Cloud Messaging API' access. Both can be overridden with the Fcm__ProjectId / Fcm__ServiceAccountJsonPath environment variables instead of editing this file. Leave both empty to disable push notifications.

Tunnel._comment: Cloudflare Tunnel config (Fase 4/11). CloudflaredPath = path to cloudflared.exe, absolute or relative to the Service's install directory; defaults to 'cloudflared.exe' next to the Service executable if left empty (Fase 11's installer is responsible for placing/verifying it there). NamedTunnelToken = a Named Tunnel token for a stable relay_url (recommended); leave empty to use a Quick Tunnel instead (no Cloudflare account needed, but the URL is random and rotates on every restart). Both can be overridden with Tunnel__CloudflaredPath / Tunnel__NamedTunnelToken environment variables. If cloudflared.exe is missing, Ruta C (push auth via internet) is simply unavailable — direct transports (BT/TCP/UDP) and Ruta B are unaffected.
